# University of Surrey

> The University of Surrey is a research-led institution in Guildford, England, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs with a focus on innovation, enterprise, and global impact.

Surrey is home to over 153,000 alumni and operates a thriving innovation ecosystem including Surrey Research Park. The university emphasizes student experience, research excellence, and industry partnerships across multiple disciplines.

## Core University Information

- [University of Surrey](https://www.surrey.ac.uk): University of Surrey homepage with admissions, courses, and campus information
- [About the University of Surrey](https://www.surrey.ac.uk/about): University overview covering mission, rankings, and student experience
- [Our history](https://www.surrey.ac.uk/about/history): University history from 1966 Royal Charter through Guildford relocation
- [Facts and figures](https://www.surrey.ac.uk/about/facts): University statistics, history, rankings, and institutional data

## Study and Admissions

- [Study at Surrey](https://www.surrey.ac.uk/study): Undergraduate, postgraduate, and research program options and admissions

- [MySurrey student website](https://my.surrey.ac.uk): Student portal providing academic support and campus resources
